details:
This update for flatpak fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-34078: Arbitrary code execution via crafted symlinks in sandbox-expose options (bsc#1261769).
- CVE-2026-34079: Arbitrary file deletion on host via improper cache file path validation (bsc#1261770).
- CVE-2026-90616: missing symlink protection allows a malicious sandboxed app to obtain arbitrary read and write access
  to files on the host (bsc#1280236).
- CVE-2026-92162: path traversal via unvalidated `arch` parameter in `DeployAppstream` (bsc#1282514).
- CVE-2026-96275: arbitrary write access as root via extra-data extraction (bsc#1282515).
- CVE-2026-96276: arbitrary write in host context via `flatpak build-init` (bsc#1282516).
- CVE-2026-96280: buffer overflow in OCI delta stream path names (bsc#1282518).
- CVE-2026-96281: unprivileged active user can bypass anti-downgrade checks for system apps/runtimes (bsc#1282519).
- CVE-2026-96282: extension metadata path traversal file existence oracle (bsc#1282520).
- CVE-2026-96807: fixed-filename writes to arbitrary locations via symlink attack on `.ld.so` (bsc#1282523).
- CVE-2026-96808: `revokefs` symlink path traversal allows local privilege escalation via commit tampering
  (bsc#1282524).

Changes for flatpak:

- Update to version 1.16.6 (jsc#PED-17048):
 + Fix file descriptor leaks affecting Chromium-based browsers.
 + Fix installing extra-data without a runtime, including OpenH264.
 + Ignore unusable sandbox-expose paths for portal sub-sandboxes,
 fixing Epiphany regressions.
 + Fix installed tests and handling of standard file descriptors
 passed as invalid flatpak run arguments.
- Switch from Autotools to Meson, preserving system bubblewrap,
 xdg-dbus-proxy, curl and distribution-specific installation paths.
- Require bubblewrap >= 0.10.0 and GPGME >= 1.8.0; add Meson,
 gettext, gtk-doc and polkit-agent build dependencies and drop
 obsolete intltool and libelf build dependencies.
- Generate the system-user pre-script from the Meson build directory
 and package the tmpfiles configuration and renamed manual pages.
